task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Grab the dark gray palm-sized mouse with the right arm and lay it onto the Gray colored mat.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高度稳定性，不变形，进入框架，用右臂抓住深灰色巴掌大小的鼠标，将其放在灰色垫子上。
